name: Momoi Airi
source:
Airi was once a popular idol who appeared on a lot of variety shows. She came across as strong-minded and somewhat pushy, but she truly loved and was both passionate and proud of her work as an idol. Due to certain circumstances, she has quit her talent agency and retired from the idol world.

She's part of the idol unit MORE MORE JUMP!.

[From in-game profile]
